name: Session Persistence & Polish
summary: Add export history tracking, improve auto-save status indicator, add draft recovery notification, and update i18n strings. Auto-save already works via useDraftCache — focus is on UX polish and the missing export history feature.
approach: Incremental feature addition building on existing hooks pattern. New useExportHistory hook follows useDraftCache/useAppUiPersistence conventions. Minimal changes to DocumentEditor for status indicator and recovery banner.
